intent.note: Clause 1, 'Only when nothing is drawn AND phases outside the current View match, the empty state names the count and the view, and offers a button that switches the View to all phases ... Otherwise the existing sentence stays. When results are shown there is no standing row': filters.js counts `if (matchAll && !showP) { outP++; ... }` off the verdict refresh() already reaches (no second pass, as asked), then `norowOutside.hidden = !(empty && outP > 0)` and `norowSays.hidden = empty && outP > 0`, and the text is 'No phase in ' + viewName() + ' matches — ' + plural(outP, segs + ' phase does', ...). _report_page.py renders the plain sentence in its own unhidden slot and the data-outside slot hidden, with Show all phases. No notice outside the empty row. Clause 'The new button reuses the View control's own path (set it and dispatch its change)': `viewSel.value = 'all'; viewSel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))`, which reaches heatmap.js setView -> refresh -> syncHash, so the hash and storage follow. Clause 2, 'The counter states its basis at rest and filtered ... M uses the same basis as the header's task total (cancelled excluded)': count = visP + ' of ' + plural(phaseRows.length,'phase') + ' (' + viewName() + ')' at rest and filtered, plus tasks when filtering. totT and visT now skip data-status cancelled, which matches _status_facts.py:1331 (total = len(tasks) - cancelled) that the header prints.
